# DeepKids — EscapeGravity

> EscapeGravity is an educational science board game for kids ages 7+, made by DeepKids in India. Players race a board piece toward the International Space Station while fighting "Gravity" using Force Cards earned by completing real, physical, hands-on challenges — learning concepts like gravity, forces, and air resistance by doing them, not just reading about them. 2–6 players, about 30 minutes per game.

EscapeGravity is available to order in India. The box includes a spiral game board, 13 Force Cards, 35+ Physical Challenge Cards, player tokens, and science tiles. Category: educational board game, STEM toy, science learning game for kids, family board game.

Four billion years as one continuous story across 76 chapters, from the silent infinite before time to what happens after us — the birth of the Earth, cyanobacteria oxygenating a dying world, the argument that thought predates neurons, and the questions evolution raises rather than settles. Every one of the 51 spreads is painted for this book alone, and readable on the page. Unlike most evolution books it carries no human-supremacy bias: RNA, plants and other animals are treated as the intelligent, adaptive life they are.
